notes:
After a warp or a map change the bot used to sit still for about six seconds before doing anything. That wait is now 3.5 seconds, so it gets back to work roughly 2.5 seconds sooner.

Separately, a buff or summon cast that never finished could leave the bot quietly stuck at the worst possible moment, not healing and not attacking until something knocked it loose. A stuck cast now times out by itself within a few seconds and the bot carries on. If the bot ever stopped on you with a shop or window open and would not recover, this is the most likely cause and it is closed.

Update as usual, the app reinstalls itself cleanly.
